body:
Addressed in be8bc6b13f28afd03c835211f98f608909b84b6f. ShortcutEditor now reports placeholder changes on recording start and finish; the sizing family schedules from that explicit callback through a guarded QPointer. LayoutRequest feedback remains disabled.

The new isolated GUI case holds the surrounding geometry steady, leaves every shortcut empty, verifies no textChanged signal, checks the recording prompt fits, and checks cancellation restores the original width. It fails on 818bfc95 and passes in the full 114-test run on be8bc6b1, with retries disabled. I also added the wrapped-label height assertion from the review nitpick.
